channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Looking for Greenlight: Blood Angels" - I made an SCP With another SCP Author, who claimed that the SCP Itself is fine, and is a pretty decent idea. As well, Another friend of mine is making an artistic rendition of the SCP.

item.title: Re: JS Staff Post -- Forum Crit -- Info
JS Staff Post -- Forum Crit -- Info
item.content:encoded:
Author,

Per the required reading forum guidelines, please fill out the concept template to seek feedback on your idea:

 **Seeking Greenlights:** Put yes or no. **Page Type:** SCP Article, Tale, GoI Format, Joke SCP, Site Dossier, Other (specify) **Genre (Optional):** Horror, Drama/Emotional, Comedy, Action, History, Other (specify) **Page Layout (Optional):** [How will you will structure the page in terms of information presentation, or plot development? If you plan on using a unique format/format screw, describe that here.] **Elevator Pitch:** [What is the basic core idea? Use a bullet point list if necessary.] **Central Narrative:** [Describe the story beats or overarching context/"big picture" for your piece. If there is no story content, put "none".] **Hook/Attention-Grabber:** [What is novel/unique about your premise? What is special about your idea here that will make it stand out among the other works already on the mainsite?] **Additional Notes:** [Note any concerns or particular areas of assistance you would like reviewers to focus on.]

Rather than posting a new comment, edit your previous post using the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of your first comment.

Remember that the combined text for your answers to the last four sections (Elevator Pitch, Central Narrative, Hook/Attention-Grabber, and Additional Notes) MAY NOT exceed 400 words. For convenience, authors can use this page to check wordcount: https://wordcounter.net/

Once you have revised your post accordingly, please reach out to reviewers to request that they look at your thread. You can find example lists of contacts in the Required Reading thread linked above.

item.title: Looking for Greenlight: Blood Angels
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): ???

Elevator Pitch: An Orb that glows a bright red, that when touched converts any humanoid into one of it's own
type of monster, a Blood Angel, where the humanoid that touched it has it's skin disintegreated and is converted into
a figure with fleshy like wings. It isn't sentient, but knows when something is approaching it with the intent to harm
or destroy it, and so if no blood angels are around, the orb itself isn't able to be destroyed, but grows weaker with
each blood angel it's created. Blood Angels themselves will be idle, and are only hostile if any humanoid comes in proximity
of them, to which they will try and force whatever humanoid is around them to touch it, and can only be neutralized via
being sprayed by water.

Central Narrative: An Orb that has been worshipped for decades by cults.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The Orb creates these unknown beings that seem to exist only to protect the orb's existence.
stuck between it being a civilization, or a way for the orb to extend itself onto people, to protect it.

Additional Notes:
I'm stuck on a couple of concepts, but have been told that the idea itself is a good one. Also, it's object class is safe, it only does it's thing if touched.
